title: Hasan Qamar of Chiniot
takeaway: Friends who wrote together leave pearls behind them.
scene: A short tribute to Hasan Qamar Chinioti, a poet friend. Below it, the editor adds a note: 'The Doctor also wrote many sorrowful verses for friends who left this passing world. Some are recorded here as a sample.' The poems that follow are elegies.

original: سخن وری دا قمرؔ تے بادشاہ سی پاندا تاریاں اتے کمند ہے سی
کدی اوکڑاں کولوں نہ ہار کھادی سوچ فکر چ بڑا بلند ہے سی
transliteration: Sukhan-vari da Qamar te baadshaah si, paanda taariyaan utte kamand hai si
Kadi aukraan kolon na haar khaadi, soch fikar ch bara buland hai si
translation: Qamar was a king of poetry who threw his rope up to the stars;
he never gave in to hardship, and he was lofty in thought.
couplets.story: Qamar was a king of poetry who aimed for the stars. He never let hard times beat him, and his ideas were always big.

original: ملیا جہنوں وی خشی دے نال ملیا متھا چودھویں رات دا چند ہے سی
بحر سخن دا قمر انمول موتی اہل قلم نوں بڑا پسند ہے سی
transliteration: Miliya jinhu vi khushi de naal miliya, mattha chaudhveen raat da chand hai si
Behr-e-sukhan da Qamar anmol moti, ahl-e-qalam nu bara pasand hai si
translation: Whoever he met, he met with joy; his forehead was like the full moon.
Qamar was a priceless pearl in the ocean of poetry, much loved by writers.
couplets.story: He greeted everyone happily, and his face glowed like a full moon. In the world of poetry he was a priceless pearl, and other writers loved him.

original: رہ رہ کے اوہدی پئی یاد آوے سخن ور سوہنے کٹھے ہوئے ہوئے نیں
دوروں نیڑیوں آئے نیں جو احمدؔ موتی پیار دے دھاگے پروئے ہوئے نیں
transliteration: Reh reh ke ohdi pai yaad aave, sukhan-var sohne katthe hoe hoe nain
Dooron neriyon aaye nain jo Ahmad, moti pyaar de dhaage paroe hoe nain
translation: Again and again I remember him, when fine poets have gathered together;
Ahmad, those who've come from near and far are pearls strung on a thread of love.
couplets.story: Whenever the poets get together, he keeps remembering Qamar. Friends come from near and far, like pearls on one string, held together by love.

why: It shows the warm friendships between poets, and introduces the section of the book where Dr. Ahmad remembers friends who have died.
prompt: Who are the 'pearls on your string', the friends who hold your group together?

editorNote.original: ڈاکٹر ہوراں فانی دنیا نوں چھڈ کے جان والیاں بیلیاں واسطے بوہت کجھ درداں بھرے شعر وی لکھے۔ ونگی دے طور تے درج کر رہیا آں
editorNote.translation: The Doctor also wrote many sorrowful verses for friends who left this passing world. I am recording some here as a sample.

notes: The editor's note at the bottom of the page introduces the elegies that follow.
